faqs.question: Do vinyl staircases look as good as hardwood?
faqs.answer: When installed properly with quality vinyl and matching nosings, the result is sharp and clean. Vinyl stairs are also more durable and easier to maintain than carpet - they don't stain, trap allergens, or show wear the same way. Our gallery shows what a finished install looks like.

why_us: BUILT TO LAST - Vinyl stair treads are engineered for high-traffic areas. They resist scratches, dents, and daily wear far better than carpet or traditional hardwood. In a Halifax home with kids, pets, or heavy foot traffic, vinyl holds up year after year without showing its age.
EASY TO CLEAN - No more vacuuming carpet stairs or worrying about spills soaking in. Vinyl treads wipe clean. No special cleaners, no refinishing, no annual upkeep.
LOOKS LIKE HARDWOOD - Modern vinyl treads copy the look of real hardwood or stone closely. You get a high-end look without the high-end price or fragility.

SAFER THAN CARPET - Loose or worn carpet on stairs is a tripping hazard. Vinyl treads provide a firm, consistent surface with defined nosing edges. They offer better grip underfoot and eliminate the risks that come with aging carpet.
COST-EFFECTIVE UPGRADE - Compared to hardwood stair refinishing or a full staircase rebuild, vinyl tread installation usually costs less and still changes how the stairs look.

MOISTURE & PET FRIENDLY - Living in Halifax means dealing with wet boots, snow, and salt. Vinyl is fully waterproof and will not warp, stain, or absorb odours. It is the ideal choice for pet owners and families in the Maritime climate.

faqs.question: What areas do you cover for repair and renovation work?
faqs.answer: We serve all of Halifax Regional Municipality - Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville, Cole Harbour, Fall River, Eastern Passage, Timberlea, Hammonds Plains, Tantallon, Waverley, Enfield, Elmsdale, Porters Lake, and surrounding communities.

faqs.question: How quickly can ETRA start on a repair project?
faqs.answer: It depends on our current schedule, but we work hard to accommodate timely repairs. Contact us and let us know what you need - we'll give you an honest timeline and do our best to fit you in quickly.
